text:
If possible, go to your nearest playground. Alternatively, play the game with furniture, such as chairs, tables and sofas.

What can you go in, under, over, through, behind, in front of or on?

Challenge your child to go under something. Then, challenge them with a different position.

Repeat the activity as many times as possible to practise position words.
